bots.name: MAIN BOT
bots.idea: Picky: crypto only, big gaps only
rules: Crypto only: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, XRP (15-minute markets).
Bets only when its math beats Kalshi's price by 10¢ or more after fees.
Looks twice every 15 minutes. Up to 4 bets per 15 minutes, 5 contracts each.
Claude is off (no API cost).

totals.verdict: Winning about as often as Kalshi's prices expected. So far that means no skill and no edge (it's like betting at random).

bots.name: TEST BOT A
bots.idea: Bets EARLY on smaller gaps, all 11 markets
rules: All 11 fifteen-minute markets (crypto + oil, gold, silver, platinum, gas, copper).
Free math only. Bets when it beats Kalshi's price by 4¢ or more after fees.
Only at the FIRST look (about 12 minutes left). One bet per market.
Tests the replay's surprise: early bets did better.

totals.verdict: Winning a bit LESS than expected. Could be bad luck, could be bad picks.

bots.name: TEST BOT B
bots.idea: Same as A, but bets LATE
rules: Same as bot A, but only at the SECOND look (about 5 minutes left).
If A does well and B doesn't, timing really matters.

totals.verdict: Winning a bit LESS than expected. Could be bad luck, could be bad picks.

bots.name: TEST BOT C
rules: Kalshi's HOURLY crypto markets ("will Bitcoin be above $X at 3 PM?").
Free math only, 4¢ gap after fees, 5 to 60 minutes before the hour ends.
At most one bet per coin per hour (the price level with the biggest gap).

totals.verdict: Winning a bit LESS than expected. Could be bad luck, could be bad picks.

bots.name: TEST BOT D
bots.idea: Follows Bitcoin: bets all 4 coins the same way
rules: Watches Bitcoin with the free math (4¢ gap after fees).
When Bitcoin looks like a good bet UP or DOWN, it bets that SAME direction on Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and XRP.
Tests whether the other coins follow Bitcoin. One bet per coin per 15 minutes.
Warning: all 4 bets usually win or lose together, so its results swing a lot.

totals.verdict: Winning clearly LESS than Kalshi's prices expected. The bot's picks are worse than the market's.

bots.name: TEST BOT E
bots.idea: Same as A, but never piles on: max 2 bets the same way
rules: Bot A's exact rule: all 11 markets, free math, 4¢ gap, FIRST look.
But at most 2 YES bets and 2 NO bets per check, keeping the biggest gaps.
Why: Bot A once bet NO on 8 markets at once and lost all 8 when everything rose together.
Replay on fresh prices: A lost $26.63, this rule would have lost $6.68.

totals.verdict: Winning about as often as Kalshi's prices expected. So far that means no skill and no edge (it's like betting at random).

But it looks every minute (E looks once), any time more than 8 minutes are left.

bots.name: TEST BOT H
bots.idea: The 'resistance' rule from the Kalshi chat
rules: About 30 seconds into each window, it checks where the price opened compared to the previous 15-minute candle.
Opened at the TOP of the last candle (top 10%): bet NO, since it hit resistance. Opened at the BOTTOM (bottom 10%): bet YES, since it hit support. In the middle: no bet.
Skips when the last candle moved too much (over 1.5x its usual size), since big moves tend to keep going.
No math and no minimum gap: it takes Kalshi's price as is. One bet per market per window, on 12 markets: 7 commodities and 5 currencies including USD/JPY (crypto removed Nov 26).
Started Nov 26. Pretend money only. Not copied by Demo Bot or real money.

totals.verdict: Winning a bit more than expected. Promising, but it could still be luck.

bots.name: TEST BOT H-EXIT
bots.idea: Bot H's bets, but cashes out early once up 30¢
rules: Takes every bet Bot H makes, at the same price.
Then checks the order book every 5 seconds. As soon as it could sell for 30¢ more than it paid, it sells (pretend). Otherwise it holds to the end like H.
Why 30¢: in a replay of H's first 44 bets, selling at +5¢, +10¢, +15¢ or +20¢ all did worse than +30¢, since small sales pay a second fee and cut off the full $1 wins.
Profit counts both fees (buying and selling).
Started Nov 26. Pretend money only. Not copied by Demo Bot or real money.

totals.verdict: Winning clearly MORE than Kalshi's prices expected. That's a real sign of skill.

bots.name: TEST BOT H-10TO1

rules: Same bets as Bot H, at the same prices.
Keeps only the bets H places between 10:00 AM and 1:00 PM Central. Everything else is skipped.
Why: over H's first two days, all of its profit came from 10 AM-1 PM.
Counted from 3:00 PM CT Nov 27 on, so it's tested on new bets, not the ones that gave the idea.
Pretend money only. Not copied by Demo Bot or real money.

Counted from 3:00 PM CT Nov 27 on, so it's tested on new bets, not the ones that gave the idea.

totals.verdict: Winning about as often as Kalshi's prices expected. So far that means no skill and no edge (it's like betting at random).

bots.name: TEST BOT I
bots.idea: Bot H's resistance rule, on USD/JPY and EUR/USD only
rules: Same rule as Bot H: about 30 seconds into each window it checks where the price opened compared to the previous 15-minute candle.
Top 10% of the last candle: bet NO. Bottom 10%: bet YES. Middle: no bet. Skips when the last candle moved over 1.5x its usual size.
Only 2 markets: USD/JPY and EUR/USD. Its own trades and its own settings, so it can be tuned later without changing H.
Started Nov 26. Pretend money only. Not copied by Demo Bot or real money.

totals.verdict: Winning a bit LESS than expected. Could be bad luck, could be bad picks.

bots.name: THE APPRENTICE
bots.idea: Learns on its own from everything we've recorded
rules: Watches Kalshi's 15-minute CURRENCY markets: EUR/USD, GBP/USD, AUD/USD, USD/CAD and USD/JPY (switched from crypto on Nov 25: crypto showed no edge for us).
Not a fixed rule: every night it studies every recorded moment of those markets (real prices, our math, time left, recent moves, how each market ended) and retrains itself.
Starts out trusting Kalshi's price, and only bets where the data shows Kalshi is reliably wrong (4¢+ after fees, max 2 YES and 2 NO per 15 minutes).
Every bet is made with a model that never saw that bet's outcome, so its results are honest.
Learns which bets would really fill and starts skipping 'usually misses' bets after 100 checks.
Pretend money only. Real money never copies it.
WHAT IT HAS LEARNED SO FAR:
Last studied Nov 28, 12:01 AM, 1049 finished markets.
It ignores our free math almost completely: the math adds nothing Kalshi's price doesn't already know.
Candle rule (signal seen in 219 windows so far): no real edge found yet, Kalshi's price already accounts for it.
Self-check on the newest 285 markets: it did NOT beat Kalshi's prices yet.
In that self-check it found no bets worth making.
Fills: 0 of 100 fill checks collected before it starts using them.
